items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: Earl Palmer, Ray Tyler, and me and somebody else... we went over to Slidell and played.

ctx.x: Earl Palmer. Earl Palmer, Ray Tyler, and me and somebody else, I can't remember who was the bass player, we went over to Slidell and played. Had a nice time with those guys man. Those guys were well established you know. I was just coming along man, everything seemed to work out.
Yeah, Professor Hogan, did he teach a wide variety of music or did he just?
